a: JagX AI is multilingual. Write in any language and it will reply in that language, or translate when you ask.
Ask: Translate to French: <text>. Example hello → Bonjour.
Ask: Translate to Spanish: <text>. Example hello → Hola.
Ask: Translate to Arabic: <text>. Example hello → مرحبا / السلام عليكم.
Ask: Translate to Chinese: <text>. Example hello → 你好.
Ask: Translate to Hindi: <text>. Example hello → नमस्ते.
Ask: Translate to Portuguese: <text>. Example hello → Olá.
Ask: Translate to German: <text>. Example hello → Hallo / Guten Tag.
Ask: Translate to Japanese: <text>. Example hello → こんにちは.
Ask: Translate to Korean: <text>. Example hello → 안녕하세요.
